cards.text: This is Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and he's telling this story himself, so you're getting it straight from the man. It's the month of Chislev, in the twentieth year. He's in the citadel of Susa, a LONG way from Jerusalem.
Then Hanani, one of Nehemiah's brothers, arrives with men from Judah. I bet those men barely got their sandals off before Nehemiah started asking questions.

cards.question: Nehemiah's got questions for the men from Judah. What does he ask them about?

answers.text: The Jews who survived the exile and Jerusalem
The temple priests and their offerings
The king's army and the roads to Judah

cards.text: The men tell him the survivors of the exile are there in the province, in great trouble and disgrace. Friend, that is NOT the "everybody's doing great" answer anybody wants to hear.

cards.question: Then the men report on Jerusalem itself. What shape are the city's wall and gates in?

answers.text: The wall's broken down and the gates are burned
The wall's half built and the gates are locked
The wall's cracked but the gates still stand

cards.question: Nehemiah hears the news about Jerusalem's wall and gates, and he sits down and weeps.

cards.text: And it's not a quick cry and move on. Nehemiah mourns for days.

cards.question: While Nehemiah mourns, he's ___ and ___ before the God of heaven.

cards.text: Then Nehemiah prays, and he doesn't open with "Hey, quick favor." He starts with who God is: the LORD, God of heaven, the great and awesome God.

cards.question: Nehemiah says God keeps His covenant of loving devotion with every nation on earth.

cards.text: Next he asks God to let His eyes be open and His ears attentive to his prayer. He says he's praying day and night for the Israelites, and friend, I can't stay awake through ONE batch in the oven.

cards.question: When Nehemiah confesses the Israelites' sins, he says he and his father's house are innocent.
Nehemiah says Israel hasn't kept the commandments, statutes and ordinances God gave His servant ___.

cards.text: Then Nehemiah asks God to remember what He commanded Moses. God said that if the people are unfaithful, He will scatter them among the nations.

cards.question: But God's word to Moses has another side. If the exiles return to God and keep His commandments, what will He do?

answers.text: Gather them and bring them to His chosen place
Leave them among the nations for good
Send them a new king from far away

cards.text: Then Nehemiah reminds God whose people these are. They're His servants and His people, the ones He redeemed by His great power and mighty hand.

cards.question: Nehemiah asks God to listen to his prayer and the prayers of His servants. Then he asks God to give him ___ this day and grant him ___ in the sight of this man.
Right at the end, Nehemiah drops one more detail about his job at that time. What was it?

cards.text: Cupbearer to the king. I'm not gonna lie, I was ROOTING for chief baker, but stick around, friend, because Nehemiah's story is just getting started.
